core_obligations: Establish the equivalence of the three chartwise conditions using descent of the Cohen-Macaulay property along surjective etale morphisms.
Prove the pointwise equivalence by comparing the strict local rings and reducing to the schemes case.

proof_roadmap.step: Set up a surjective etale chart by a scheme and reduce the chartwise conditions.
Show the conditions are equivalent by etale descent.
Prove the pointwise criterion via the strict local rings.

difficulty_reason: The algebraic-spaces criterion for the Cohen-Macaulay property: the lemma gives three equivalent chartwise conditions using surjective etale charts by schemes, and separately a pointwise equivalence comparing the strict local rings of a point and its image. The proof establishes the equivalence of the chartwise conditions using that the property descends along surjective etale morphisms, and then the pointwise criterion by passing to the strict local rings and applying the scheme case there. The chart descent together with the strict-local-ring comparison is the substance. Retained author proof at lines 6240-6263 statement, proof 6265-6308.

compared.difference: Hypothesis difference: this side treats a morphism of algebraic spaces over S; the schemes side treats a morphism of schemes. Conclusion difference: this side has three chartwise conditions and a separate pointwise equivalence involving strict local rings, versus two conditions on the schemes side, so the propositions differ and both count.
